body: Type=simple only guaranteed the process forked, not that the HTTP listener was accepting connections — emily-system.service's After=iduna.service ordering didn't mean real readiness. ExecStartPost now polls /health up to 30s before the unit is considered started. Commit 7b19088. Found during pre-reboot hardening audit.
title: iduna.service: add ExecStartPost health-check gate for boot ordering correctness
